race.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (Div 2)
race.verdict: NATIVE HONEY has struggled for consistency but he's unexposed on all-weather and a 3 lb higher mark for his win over C&D 6 weeks earlier looks well within his compass. Stenmark and Decem Starr are a couple of others to consider. NATIVE HONEY (IRE) STENMARK (IRE) DECEM STARR (IRE)
